LESSON: KUANDIKA 15.3.1 KUANDIKA KIDIJITALI BARUAPEPE

Grade: Grade 7
Subject: KISWAHILI
Strand: Strand 15
Topic 15.3: Kuandika 15.3.1 Kuandika Kidijitali Baruapepe

SEHEMU 1: KARIBU

Habari! Leo tutajifunza kuhusu Kuandika 15.3.1 Kuandika Kidijitali Baruapepe. Soma, angalia mifano, fanya mazoezi, kisha jaribu jaribio la marekebisho.

SEHEMU 2: UTAPATA KUJUA NINI

Mwisho wa somo hili, utaweza:

1. kutambua ujumbe unaoafiki baruapepe kwa rafiki
2. kutambua vipengele vya kimuundo vya baruapepe kwa rafiki
3. kutumia lugha inayofaa katika uandishi wa baruapepe kwa rafiki

SEHEMU 3: JIFUNZE HATUA KWA HATUA

1. kutambua ujumbe unaoafiki baruapepe kwa rafiki
   In simple words: practise until you can kutambua ujumbe unaoafiki baruapepe kwa rafiki. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. kutambua vipengele vya kimuundo vya baruapepe kwa rafiki
   In simple words: practise until you can kutambua vipengele vya kimuundo vya baruapepe kwa rafiki. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

3. kutumia lugha inayofaa katika uandishi wa baruapepe kwa rafiki
   In simple words: practise until you can kutumia lugha inayofaa katika uandishi wa baruapepe kwa rafiki. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SEHEMU 4: MIFANO

Example 1: Talk about Kuandika 15.3.1 Kuandika Kidijitali Baruapepe using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SEHEMU 5: JARIBU HIVI

1. Underline two new ideas about Kuandika 15.3.1 Kuandika Kidijitali Baruapepe in the examples.
2. Explain Kuandika 15.3.1 Kuandika Kidijitali Baruapepe to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Kuandika 15.3.1 Kuandika Kidijitali Baruapepe.
4. Show that you can: kutambua ujumbe unaoafiki baruapepe kwa rafiki

SEHEMU 6: KAZI YA KUFANYA

1. Write five sentences about Kuandika 15.3.1 Kuandika Kidijitali Baruapepe using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Kuandika 15.3.1 Kuandika Kidijitali Baruapepe important for a Grade 7 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SEHEMU: KUMBUKA

1. kutambua ujumbe unaoafiki baruapepe kwa rafiki
2. kutambua vipengele vya kimuundo vya baruapepe kwa rafiki
3. kutumia lugha inayofaa katika uandishi wa baruapepe kwa rafiki

Sasa fanya Jaribio la Marekebisho. Angalia Majibu baada tu ya kumaliza.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
